initiatives.name: Chehalis River Mutual Aid
initiatives.description: Volunteer mutual aid network in Grays Harbor County, WA that runs a local Food Not Bombs chapter, does homeless outreach, and distributes food and supplies.

initiatives.name: The Blackflower Collective
initiatives.description: Collectively owned land and housing co-op in Grays Harbor County, WA with a permaculture farm; it also hosts community events such as May Day on the Harbor.

initiatives.name: Aberdeen IWW
initiatives.description: Local branch of the Industrial Workers of the World (IWW) in Aberdeen, WA; its site covers workplace organizing and homeless union organizing.
